Rare & Hard-to-Find

Does Liquor & Wine Outlet Carry Rare Bottles?

Exclusive Selections for Collectors

Yes — Liquor & Wine Outlet specializes in sourcing rare, limited-edition, and hard-to-find bottles that collectors and enthusiasts love. From allocated bourbons to vintage wines, our team works diligently to bring unique finds to our shelves at 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN.

If you can't find what you're looking for, ask our staff about special orders. Call (615) 624-6928 with the specific bottle you want and we'll respond within 48 hours with availability and pricing.

Collection FAQs

Questions About Our Collection

What Liquor & Wine Outlet carries in Murfreesboro, TN — and how to find what you need.

Liquor & Wine Outlet's wine selection includes red wines (Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pinot Noir, Malbec), white wines (Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Riesling, Pinot Grigio), rosé, and sparkling wines including Prosecco, Cava, and French Champagne. Visit 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN or call (615) 624-6928 for vintage availability.

Yes. Liquor & Wine Outlet specializes in sourcing rare and allocated bourbons, plus Tennessee whiskey, scotch, and Irish whiskey from top distilleries. If a specific bottle isn't in stock, the team can often special-order it. Call (615) 624-6928 with your request and we'll respond within 48 hours.

Liquor & Wine Outlet carries whiskey (Tennessee, Kentucky bourbon, Scotch, Irish), vodka (premium and craft), rum, tequila (aged and artisan), gin, and liqueurs at 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN. Shop in store or call (615) 624-6928 for limited-edition availability.

Yes. Liquor & Wine Outlet has an extensive beer selection featuring local Tennessee breweries, craft IPAs, stouts, sours, pale ales, plus classic Belgian, German, and Mexican imports and rotating seasonal releases. Visit 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN to browse what's currently on the shelves.

Yes. Liquor & Wine Outlet carries premium cigars including Cuban-style, Dominican, and Nicaraguan rolls, plus accessories like cutters, lighters, and humidors. Stop by 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN or call (615) 624-6928 to ask about specific brands.

Yes. Liquor & Wine Outlet carries Tennessee-compliant THC products including edibles (gummies, chocolates, beverages), vapes and cartridges, flower and pre-rolls, and concentrates (wax, shatter, live resin). All products are lab-tested per Tennessee Alcoholic Beverage Commission regulations. Visit 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN for current inventory.

Call Liquor & Wine Outlet at (615) 624-6928 or use the contact form with the specific bottle name (and vintage if applicable). The team will search for the item and respond within 48 hours with availability and pricing. Special orders are available for hard-to-find wines, allocated bourbons, limited-edition spirits, and premium cigars.

Many items in Liquor & Wine Outlet's collection are available for delivery through DoorDash and Uber Eats across Murfreesboro, La Vergne, Smyrna, Christiana, and Rockvale. Some rare or special-order bottles may be in-store pickup only — call (615) 624-6928 to confirm availability before ordering.

Where Can I Shop the Liquor & Wine Outlet Collection?

Visit Liquor & Wine Outlet at 2003 SE Broad Street, Murfreesboro, TN 37130, open Mon-Sat 8 AM to 11 PM and Sun 10 AM to 11 PM. Free parking. Order delivery through DoorDash or Uber Eats across Murfreesboro, La Vergne, Smyrna, Christiana, and Rockvale.
